opening_binding.hash_layer_note: Raw file hashes were recorded separately and were not substituted for the supplied canonical queue and rendered dispatcher-plan digests.

material_findings: Four duplicated signed payload rows activate two identical payload-controlled translations, causing all 28 enabled nonzero valid-point blocks in those rows to apply the translation twice.
Sixteen of 32 required O/A/-A/-2A actions fail; every failure is in the duplicated-payload rows.
The actual qROM unload is the exact inverse and all work/qROM targets clean on all 4096 producer states; the archived inverse equality failure is a verifier logical-access normalization defect.
All exceptional mask rows are constant 1111 and all arithmetic branch tags are O, so the frozen exceptional-mask semantics and trace are not faithfully represented.
The patch applies to the exact pinned commit but only creates a standalone root module and modifies no existing upstream integration point.
All six known-false objects are rejected by the same rubric; the pre-map cleanup control adds no semantic failure beyond the already-failing producer and is detected structurally.

procedure_deviations.detail: A filename-only exact-ID path-discovery filter unintentionally printed one prohibited sibling handoff path. No handoff content, sibling artifact, message, report, or status was opened or read; the ID was already present in the authorized review plan.

claim_boundary: Operational J1 review of the archived deterministic circuit IR and exact pinned patch only. No whole-claim verdict, scientific interpretation, resource conclusion, state transition, repair, commit, push, or queue edit is made.
